GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.title: Gu Hand
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.descriptio: Displays Gu Worms with activations remaining as an extra hand. Play Activate before choosing a Gu card; canceling target selection keeps activation mode active.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.title: Gu Recovery Pile
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.descript: Stores depleted Gu Worms. Each Gu Worm has an independent recovery time based on its type and rank; some rank-3 or higher Gu create normal derivative cards when entering or progressing through recovery.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.empty: The Gu Recovery Pile is empty.
